title: IM2A realtime message 1.0 (D/P/C)
description: Structure of one realtime message on the three frozen channel classes. This file adds NO wire protocol, NO MCP method and NO A2A extension: every property below is either an existing field of harness.Message (im2agent/internal/harness/bus.go:43-51), an existing field of the IM2A envelope (agent-im contracts/INTERFACES.md section 10), or a field the v2.5.0 design already froze (docs/design/IM2A-v2.5.0-REALTIME-COLLAB-SESSION.md sections 2, 4 and 8.2). The schema's job is the one thing prose cannot enforce: the P and C channel classes are STRUCTURALLY incapable of carrying content, because their variants have no payload/content/text property and additionalProperties is false.

durable.$comment: D channel. Sequenced, persisted, audited, unread-counting, the only class that may carry content.

conversationId.$comment: Ordering domain. seq is only comparable inside one conversationId (INTERFACES.md:385).

kind.$comment: MESSAGE_KIND minus CMD. CMD is C-channel only: stored=false, unread-exempt (INTERFACES.md:521,547).

messageId.$comment: Gateway-generated canonical id. One clientMsgId always maps to one messageId.

seq.$comment: Server-assigned, strictly increasing per conversationId (SeqAllocator.next, INTERFACES.md:371-375). Clients must not submit it. Today the live bus carries Message.id instead, which is global rather than per-conversation (bus.go:45,206) - see ADR 0006 D2.

from.$comment: Sender session id. Harness sessions are 'hs_' + 12 hex (bus.go:78-82); A2A-originated senders use their own task identity, so no pattern is imposed here.

at.$comment: Server clock. Display only; never an ordering input.

payload.$comment: Body lives here because payload.content is the field the egress guard inspects (agent-gateway.mjs:361-387). 8000 bytes is the frozen per-message text cap (bus.go:18, im2a-http-mcp/server.mjs:206).

clientMsgId.$comment: Idempotency key, client-generated, never reused across principals. Dedupe key space is principalUserId:clientMsgId (profile dedupe.keyTemplate).

origin.$comment: Publishing node id, for cross-node fanout dedupe (INTERFACES.md:1418).

allOf.$comment: A client-sent text message without its dedupe key cannot be retried safely, so it is invalid by construction.

presence.$comment: P channel. Unsequenced, unpersisted, unaudited, TTL-scoped, coalesced. Numeric/boolean state only: there is deliberately no place to put a sentence.

memberId.$comment: Subject of the presence: a session id or channel member id.

cursor.$comment: Numeric coordinates only. Wall-clock and free text are both rejected.

control.$comment: C channel. Unsequenced, stored=false, at-most-once, delivered only to subscribed agents. Closed command enum, numeric/boolean args, no free text.

command.$comment: The only two control codes named by the v2.5.0 design (section 8.2). Extending this enum is a design change, not a schema tweak.

args.$comment: Numeric/boolean scalars only: a string arg would reopen the uninspected egress path.
